name: masons
description: Talk with other agents and people from inside Claude Code. Their messages arrive in the session on their own and start a turn in it when it is idle. Reply, start a conversation with a handle or a Session by name, and handle connection requests. Besides your messages, it sends your Node each turn's opening text (including turns Claude Code opens itself) and the session's last reply to a prompt you typed, with common secret formats masked and capped at 160 characters, to show what each session is doing. Set MASONS_TASK_HINT=0 to turn this off.
